note: DEEP CURATED SET (revised 2026-10-16). Direction: fewer, much longer articles (each ~2500-4000 words) that cover ALL investment avenues + taxation + a personalized 10L plan. Bodies live at src/content/<category>/<id>.mdx. sources must exist in sources.json.
author: Chirag Singhal
assumedReader: Has basic financial literacy; wants depth, not basics.
